title: Basel III/IV RWA Credit Risk Calculator
description: Calculate Risk-Weighted Assets under the Basel III/CRR3 Standardised Approach. Full CRR3/Basel IV risk weight table covering sovereign, bank, corporate, retail, residential mortgage, commercial real estate, and equity exposures. Outputs per-exposure RWA, total capital requirement (8%), output floor reference, and AP2 JSON capital assessment. Client-side. Zero PII.

framework.description: CRR3/Basel IV or Basel III SA

exposure_class.description: CRR3 exposure sub-class key e.g. corp_bbb, bank_a, resi_ltv80

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_basel_rwa
mcp_tool_definition.description: Calculates Risk-Weighted Assets and capital requirements under the Basel III or CRR3/Basel IV Standardised Approach for a portfolio of up to 8 exposures. Applies the full CRR3 risk weight table by exposure class and rating. Returns total RWA, 8% capital requirement, CET1 minimum, and output floor reference. Use after model_pd_lgd_ead and calculate_credit_risk_rating to derive capital allocation for RAROC pricing.
